concerns.text: Task T013e is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`) but is required to satisfy FR-001 (ontology mapping/harmonization) and provide input for FR-008 (MICE). The spec mandates this logic; leaving the task unimplemented in the task list constitutes a silent relaxation of the requirement to produce `data/metadata/harmonized_matrix.csv`.

Task T014 (Memory Safety & Streaming) is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). FR-009 mandates random subsampling if projected memory > 6GB. Without this task implemented, the system cannot guarantee the 7GB RAM constraint (SC-005), violating the constitutional requirement for computational feasibility.

Task T046 (Power Analysis) is marked incomplete. SC-002 and the Edge Cases require explicit sample size justification and power reporting. Omitting this task means the deliverable cannot verify statistical validity, weakening the scientific claim.

Task T047 (Homogeneity of Dispersion) is marked incomplete. The Plan's 'Complexity Tracking' explicitly rejects ignoring dispersion differences as a cause for false positives in PERMANOVA. Omitting this task violates the methodological integrity required by the spec.

Task T049 (Detailed Provenance Logging) is marked incomplete. Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Principle III (Data Hygiene) require logging exact commands, versions, and checksums for every step. Without this task, the 'Reproducibility' constraint is unenforceable.

Task T013a1 describes logging a warning and proceeding in Validation Mode if <3 datasets are found, but the Spec Edge Cases mandate an immediate FATAL abort in Research Mode. The task description creates a logical gap where the abort condition might be bypassed or misimplemented, weakening the 'Dataset Availability' constraint.
